Man sent to jail for vandalising Liberation War memorial
2023-01-15T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Patuakhali
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/crime-justice/news/man-sent-jail-vandalising-liberation-war-memorial-3221156

A Patuakhali court yesterday sent a man to jail for vandalising a sculpture in Patuakhali's Dumki upazila.

Shariatullah, 20, purposefully damaged the tip of a Liberation War memorial sculpture at Joy Bangla Chattar of Dumki Upazila Complex around 10:30pm on Friday.

He was held by security guards who handed him over to the police next morning, said Abdus Salam, officer-in-charge of Dumki Police Station.

Following the incident, Syed Golam Mortoza, a former commander of Upazila Muktijoddha Sangsad, filed a case against him with police.
